tlabel: Adjustments for decrease (increase) in inventories
doc: Adjustments for decrease (increase) in inventories to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Inventories; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for decrease (increase) in other current assets
doc: Adjustments for decrease (increase) in other current assets to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Other current assets; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for decrease (increase) in trade accounts receivable
doc: Adjustments for decrease (increase) in trade accounts receivable to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for gain (loss) on disposal of investments in subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates
doc: Adjustments for gain (loss) on disposals investments in subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Associates [member]; Joint ventures [member]; Subsidiaries [member]; Investments in subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates reported in separate financial statements; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in employee benefit liabilities
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in employee benefit liabilities to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in trade accounts payable
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in trade accounts payable to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for share-based payments
doc: Adjustments for share-based payments to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Amortisation expense
doc: The amount of amortisation expense. Amortisation is the systematic allocation of depreciable amounts of intangible assets over their useful lives.

tlabel: Assets
doc: The amount of a present economic resource controlled by the entity as a result of past events. Economic resource is a right that has the potential to produce economic benefits.

tlabel: Basic earnings (loss) per share
doc: The amount of profit (loss) attributable to ordinary equity holders of the parent entity (the numerator) divided by the weighted average number of ordinary shares outstanding during the period (the denominator).

tlabel: Capital reserve
doc: A component of equity representing the capital reserves.

tlabel: Cash advances and loans made to other parties, classified as investing activities
doc: The amount of cash advances and loans made to other parties (other than advances and loans made by a financial institution), classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Cash and cash equivalents
doc: The amount of cash on hand and demand deposits, along with short-term, highly liquid investments that are readily convertible to known amounts of cash and that are subject to an insignificant risk of changes in value. [Refer: Cash; Cash equivalents]

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) financing activities
doc: The cash flows from (used in) financing activities, which are activities that result in changes in the size and composition of the contributed equity and borrowings of the entity.

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) increase (decrease) in current borrowings
doc: The cash inflow (outflow) due to an increase (decrease) in current borrowings. [Refer: Current borrowings]

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) investing activities
doc: The cash flows from (used in) investing activities, which are the acquisition and disposal of long-term assets and other investments not included in cash equivalents.

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) operating activities
doc: The cash flows from (used in) operating activities, which are the principal revenue-producing activities of the entity and other activities that are not investing or financing activities. [Refer: Revenue]

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) operations
doc: The cash from (used in) the entity's operations.

tlabel: Cash receipts from repayment of advances and loans made to other parties, classified as investing activities
doc: The cash inflow from the repayment of advances and loans made to other parties (other than advances and loans of a financial institution), classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Comprehensive income
doc: The amount of change in equity resulting from transactions and other events, other than those changes resulting from transactions with owners in their capacity as owners.

tlabel: Comprehensive income, attributable to non-controlling interests
doc: The amount of comprehensive income attributable to non-controlling interests. [Refer: Comprehensive income; Non-controlling interests]

tlabel: Comprehensive income, attributable to owners of parent
doc: The amount of comprehensive income attributable to owners of the parent. [Refer: Comprehensive income]

tlabel: Cost of sales
doc: The amount of all expenses directly or indirectly attributed to the goods or services sold. Attributed expenses include, but are not limited to, costs previously included in the measurement of inventory that has now been sold, such as depreciation and maintenance of factory buildings and equipment used in the production process, unallocated production overheads, and abnormal amounts of production costs of inventories.

tlabel: Current accrued expenses and other current liabilities
doc: The amount of current accrued expenses and other current liabilities. [Refer: Accruals; Other current liabilities]

tlabel: Current assets
doc: The amount of assets that the entity (a) expects to realise or intends to sell or consume in its normal operating cycle; (b) holds primarily for the purpose of trading; (c) expects to realise within twelve months after the reporting period; or (d) classifies as cash or cash equivalents (as defined in IAS 7) unless the asset is restricted from being exchanged or used to settle a liability for at least twelve months after the reporting period. [Refer: Assets]

tlabel: Current dividend payables
doc: The amount of current dividend payables. [Refer: Dividend payables]

tlabel: Current financial assets at amortised cost
doc: The amount of current financial assets measured at amortised cost. [Refer: Financial assets at amortised cost]

tlabel: Current financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income
doc: The amount of current financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income. [Refer: Financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income]

tlabel: Current financial assets at fair value through profit or loss
doc: The amount of current financial assets measured at fair value through profit or loss. [Refer: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss]

tlabel: Current financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss
doc: The amount of current financial liabilities measured at fair value through profit or loss. [Refer: Financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss]

tlabel: Current liabilities
doc: The amount of liabilities that: (a) the entity expects to settle in its normal operating cycle; (b) the entity holds primarily for the purpose of trading; (c) are due to be settled within twelve months after the reporting period; or (d) the entity does not have the right at the end of the reporting period to defer settlement for at least twelve months after the reporting period.

tlabel: Current payables for purchase of non-current assets
doc: The amount of current payables for the purchase of non-current assets. [Refer: Payables for purchase of non-current assets]

tlabel: Current portion of non-current borrowings
doc: The current portion of non-current borrowings. [Refer: Borrowings]

tlabel: Current tax liabilities, current
doc: The current amount of current tax liabilities. [Refer: Current tax liabilities]

tlabel: Current trade receivables
doc: The amount of current trade receivables. [Refer: Trade receivables]

tlabel: Decrease (increase) through tax on share-based payment transactions, equity
doc: The decrease (increase) in equity resulting from tax on transactions in which the entity: (a) receives goods or services from the supplier of those goods or services (including an employee) in a share-based payment arrangement; or (b) incurs an obligation to settle the transaction with the supplier in a share-based payment arrangement when another group entity receives those goods or services. [Refer: Share-based payment arrangements [member]]

tlabel: Deferred tax assets
doc: The amounts of income taxes recoverable in future periods in respect of: (a) deductible temporary differences; (b) the carryforward of unused tax losses; and (c) the carryforward of unused tax credits. [Refer: Temporary differences [member]; Unused tax credits [member]; Unused tax losses [member]]

tlabel: Deferred tax liabilities
doc: The amounts of income taxes payable in future periods in respect of taxable temporary differences. [Refer: Temporary differences [member]]

tlabel: Depreciation expense
doc: The amount of depreciation expense. Depreciation is the systematic allocation of depreciable amounts of tangible assets over their useful lives.

tlabel: Diluted earnings (loss) per share
doc: The amount of profit (loss) attributable to ordinary equity holders of the parent entity (the numerator), divided by the weighted average number of ordinary shares outstanding during the period (the denominator), both adjusted for the effects of all dilutive potential ordinary shares. [Refer: Ordinary shares [member]; Weighted average [member]]

tlabel: Dividends recognised as distributions to owners
doc: The amount of dividends recognised as distributions to owners.

tlabel: Dividends paid, classified as financing activities
doc: The cash outflow for dividends paid by the entity, classified as financing activities.

tlabel: Dividends received, classified as investing activities
doc: The cash inflow from dividends received, classified as investing activities. [Refer: Dividends received]

tlabel: Dividends received from investments accounted for using equity method, classified as investing activities
doc: The cash inflow representing dividends received from investments that are accounted for using the equity method, classified as investing activities. [Refer: Investments accounted for using equity method; Dividends received]

tlabel: Effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents
doc: The effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents held or due in a foreign currency. [Refer: Cash and cash equivalents]

tlabel: Equity
doc: The amount of residual interest in the assets of the entity after deducting all its liabilities.

tlabel: Equity and liabilities
doc: The amount of the entity's equity and liabilities. [Refer: Equity; Liabilities]

tlabel: Equity attributable to owners of parent
doc: The amount of equity attributable to the owners of the parent. This specifically excludes non-controlling interest.

tlabel: Finance costs
doc: The amount of costs associated with financing activities of the entity.

tlabel: Finance income
doc: The amount of income associated with interest and other financing activities of the entity.

tlabel: Gain (loss) on hedge ineffectiveness recognised in other comprehensive income
doc: The gain (loss) recognised in other comprehensive income on hedge ineffectiveness. [Refer: Gain (loss) on hedge ineffectiveness]

tlabel: Gains (losses) on disposals of property, plant and equipment
doc: The gains (losses) on disposals of property, plant and equipment. [Refer: Property, plant and equipment]

tlabel: Foreign exchange gain (loss)
doc: The amount of exchange differences recognised in profit or loss that arise from foreign currency transactions, excluding those arising on financial instruments measured at fair value through profit or loss in accordance with IFRS 9. [Refer: At fair value [member]; Financial instruments, class [member]]

tlabel: General and administrative expense
doc: The amount of expense relating to general and administrative activities of the entity.

tlabel: Gross profit
doc: The amount of revenue less cost of sales. [Refer: Cost of sales; Revenue]

tlabel: Income taxes paid, classified as operating activities
doc: The cash outflow for income taxes paid, classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Tax expense (income)
doc: The aggregate amount included in the determination of profit (loss) for the period in respect of current tax and deferred tax. [Refer: Current tax expense (income); Deferred tax expense (income)]

tlabel: Income tax relating to components of other comprehensive income that will be reclassified to profit or loss
doc: The amount of income tax relating to amounts recognised in other comprehensive income that will be reclassified to profit or loss. [Refer: Income tax relating to components of other comprehensive income]

tlabel: Income tax relating to components of other comprehensive income that will not be reclassified to profit or loss
doc: The amount of income tax relating to amounts recognised in other comprehensive income that will not be reclassified to profit or loss. [Refer: Income tax relating to components of other comprehensive income]

tlabel: Increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents after effect of exchange rate changes
doc: The increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents after the effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents held in foreign currencies. [Refer: Cash and cash equivalents; Effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents]

tlabel: Increase (decrease) through acquisition of subsidiary, equity
doc: The increase (decrease) in equity resulting from the acquisition of subsidiaries. [Refer: Subsidiaries [member]]

tlabel: Increase (decrease) through appropriation of retained earnings, equity
doc: The increase (decrease) in equity resulting from the appropriation of retained earnings. [Refer: Retained earnings]

tlabel: Increase (decrease) through change in equity of subsidiaries, equity
doc: The increase (decrease) in the entity's equity resulting from the change in the equity of subsidiaries. [Refer: Subsidiaries [member]]

tlabel: Increase (decrease) through changes in ownership interests in subsidiaries that do not result in loss of control, equity
doc: The increase (decrease) in equity through changes in ownership interests in subsidiaries that do not result in loss of control. [Refer: Subsidiaries [member]]

tlabel: Increase (decrease) through share-based payment transactions, equity
doc: The increase (decrease) in equity resulting from share-based payment transactions. [Refer: Equity]

tlabel: Increase (decrease) through transactions with owners, equity
doc: The increase (decrease) in equity resulting from transactions with owners.

tlabel: Increase (decrease) through treasury share transactions, equity
doc: The increase (decrease) in equity resulting from treasury share transactions. [Refer: Equity; Treasury shares]

tlabel: Intangible assets and goodwill
doc: The amount of intangible assets and goodwill held by the entity. [Refer: Goodwill; Intangible assets other than goodwill]

tlabel: Interest paid, classified as financing activities
doc: The cash outflow for interest paid, classified as financing activities.

tlabel: Interest received, classified as investing activities
doc: The cash inflow from interest received, classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Current inventories
doc: The amount of current inventories. [Refer: Inventories]

tlabel: Investments accounted for using equity method
doc: The amount of investments accounted for using the equity method. The equity method is a method of accounting whereby the investment is initially recognised at cost and adjusted thereafter for the post-acquisition change in the investor's share of net assets of the investee. The investor's profit or loss includes its share of the profit or loss of the investee. The investor's other comprehensive income includes its share of the other comprehensive income of the investee. [Refer: At cost [member]]

tlabel: Issued capital
doc: The nominal value of capital issued.

tlabel: Liabilities
doc: The amount of a present obligation of the entity to transfer an economic resource as a result of past events. Economic resource is a right that has the potential to produce economic benefits.

tlabel: Non-current portion of non-current borrowings
doc: The non-current portion of non-current borrowings. [Refer: Borrowings]

tlabel: Long-term deposits
doc: The amount of long-term deposits held by the entity.

tlabel: Non-controlling interests
doc: The amount of equity in a subsidiary not attributable, directly or indirectly, to a parent. [Refer: Subsidiaries [member]]

tlabel: Non-current assets
doc: The amount of assets that do not meet the definition of current assets. [Refer: Current assets]

tlabel: Non-current financial assets at amortised cost
doc: The amount of non-current financial assets measured at amortised cost. [Refer: Financial assets at amortised cost]

tlabel: Non-current financial assets at fair value through profit or loss, mandatorily measured at fair value
doc: The amount of non-current financial assets mandatorily measured at fair value through profit or loss in accordance with IFRS 9. [Refer: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss, mandatorily measured at fair value]

tlabel: Non-current financial assets measured at fair value through other comprehensive income
doc: The amount of non-current financial assets measured at fair value through other comprehensive income. [Refer: Financial assets measured at fair value through other comprehensive income]

tlabel: Non-current lease liabilities
doc: The amount of non-current lease liabilities. [Refer: Lease liabilities]

tlabel: Non-current liabilities
doc: The amount of liabilities that do not meet the definition of current liabilities. [Refer: Current liabilities]

tlabel: Non-current portion of non-current bonds issued
doc: The non-current portion of non-current bonds issued. [Refer: Bonds issued]

tlabel: Non-current net defined benefit liability
doc: The amount of non-current net defined benefit liability. [Refer: Net defined benefit liability]

tlabel: Operating expense excluding cost of sales
doc: The amount of operating expense excluding the cost of sales. [Refer: Cost of sales]

tlabel: Other adjustments to reconcile profit (loss)
doc: Adjustments to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities that the entity does not separately disclose in the same statement or note. [Refer: Adjustments to reconcile profit (loss)]

tlabel: Other comprehensive income
doc: The amount of income and expense (including reclassification adjustments) that is not recognised in profit or loss as required or permitted by IFRSs. [Refer: IFRSs [member]]

tlabel: Other comprehensive income, before tax, exchange differences on translation of foreign operations
doc: The amount of other comprehensive income, before tax, after reclassification adjustments, related to exchange differences on translation of financial statements of foreign operations. [Refer: Other comprehensive income, before tax]

tlabel: Other comprehensive income, before tax, gains (losses) on remeasurements of defined benefit plans
doc: The amount of other comprehensive income, before tax, related to gains (losses) on remeasurements of defined benefit plans, which comprise actuarial gains and losses; the return on plan assets, excluding amounts included in net interest on the net defined benefit liability (asset); and any change in the effect of the asset ceiling, excluding amounts included in net interest on the net defined benefit liability (asset). [Refer: Other comprehensive income; Defined benefit plans [member]; Plan assets [member]; Net defined benefit liability (asset)] [Contrast: Decrease (increase) in net defined benefit liability (asset) resulting from gain (loss) on remeasurement in other comprehensive income]

tlabel: Other comprehensive income that will be reclassified to profit or loss, net of tax
doc: The amount of other comprehensive income that will be reclassified to profit or loss, net of tax. [Refer: Other comprehensive income]

tlabel: Other comprehensive income that will not be reclassified to profit or loss, net of tax
doc: The amount of other comprehensive income that will not be reclassified to profit or loss, net of tax. [Refer: Other comprehensive income]

tlabel: Other current assets
doc: The amount of current assets that the entity does not separately disclose in the same statement or note. [Refer: Current assets]

tlabel: Other current financial assets
doc: The amount of current financial assets that the entity does not separately disclose in the same statement or note. [Refer: Other financial assets; Current financial assets]

tlabel: Other gains (losses)
doc: The gains (losses) that the entity does not separately disclose in the same statement or note.

tlabel: Other non-current assets
doc: The amount of non-current assets that the entity does not separately disclose in the same statement or note. [Refer: Non-current assets]

tlabel: Other non-current liabilities
doc: The amount of non-current liabilities that the entity does not separately disclose in the same statement or note. [Refer: Non-current liabilities]

tlabel: Other operating income (expense)
doc: The amount of operating income (expense) that the entity does not separately disclose in the same statement or note.

tlabel: Other reserves
doc: A component of equity representing reserves within equity, not including retained earnings. [Refer: Retained earnings]

tlabel: Payments for debt issue costs
doc: The cash outflow for debt issue costs.

tlabel: Payments of lease liabilities, classified as financing activities
doc: The cash outflow for payment of lease liabilities, classified as financing activities. [Refer: Lease liabilities]

tlabel: Proceeds from changes in ownership interests in subsidiaries that do not result in loss of control
doc: The cash inflow from changes in ownership interests in subsidiaries that do not result in a loss of control. [Refer: Subsidiaries [member]]

tlabel: Proceeds from issue of bonds, notes and debentures
doc: The cash inflow from the issuing of bonds, notes and debentures.

tlabel: Proceeds from non-current borrowings
doc: The cash inflow from non-current borrowings obtained. [Refer: Borrowings]

tlabel: Proceeds from sales of investments accounted for using equity method
doc: The cash inflow from sales of investments accounted for using the equity method. [Refer: Investments accounted for using equity method]

tlabel: Proceeds from sales of property, plant and equipment, classified as investing activities
doc: The cash inflow from sales of property, plant and equipment, classified as investing activities. [Refer: Property, plant and equipment]

tlabel: Profit (loss)
doc: The total of income less expenses from continuing and discontinued operations, excluding the components of other comprehensive income. [Refer: Other comprehensive income]

tlabel: Profit (loss), attributable to non-controlling interests
doc: The profit (loss) from continuing and discontinued operations attributable to non-controlling interests. [Refer: Profit (loss); Non-controlling interests]

tlabel: Profit (loss), attributable to owners of parent
doc: The profit (loss) from continuing and discontinued operations attributable to owners of the parent. [Refer: Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Profit (loss) before tax
doc: The profit (loss) before tax expense or income. [Refer: Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Profit (loss) from operating activities
doc: The profit (loss) from operating activities of the entity. [Refer: Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Property, plant and equipment
doc: The amount of tangible assets that: (a) are held for use in the production or supply of goods or services, for rental to others, or for administrative purposes; and (b) are expected to be used during more than one period. Note that right-of-use assets are not included. [Contrast: Property, plant and equipment including right-of-use assets]

tlabel: Purchase of intangible assets, classified as investing activities
doc: The cash outflow for the purchases of intangible assets, classified as investing activities. [Refer: Intangible assets other than goodwill]

tlabel: Purchase of property, plant and equipment, classified as investing activities
doc: The cash outflow for the purchases of property, plant and equipment, classified as investing activities. [Refer: Property, plant and equipment]

tlabel: Repayments of bonds, notes and debentures
doc: The cash outflow for repayments of bonds, notes and debentures.

tlabel: Repayments of non-current borrowings
doc: The cash outflow for repayments of non-current borrowings. [Refer: Borrowings]

tlabel: Research and development expense
doc: The amount of expenditure directly attributable to research or development activities, recognised in profit or loss.

tlabel: Retained earnings
doc: A component of equity representing the entity's cumulative undistributed earnings or deficit.

tlabel: Revenue
doc: The income arising in the course of an entity's ordinary activities. Income is increases in assets, or decreases in liabilities, that result in increases in equity, other than those relating to contributions from holders of equity claims.

tlabel: Dividend income
doc: The amount of dividends recognised as income. Dividends are distributions of profits to holders of equity investments in proportion to their holdings of a particular class of capital.

tlabel: Interest income
doc: The amount of income arising from interest.

tlabel: Right-of-use assets
doc: The amount of assets that represent a lessee's right to use an underlying asset for the lease term that do not meet the definition of investment property. Underlying asset is an asset that is the subject of a lease, for which the right to use that asset has been provided by a lessor to a lessee.

tlabel: Sales and marketing expense
doc: The amount of expense relating to the marketing and selling of goods or services.

tlabel: Share of profit (loss) of associates accounted for using equity method
doc: The entity's share of the profit (loss) of associates accounted for using the equity method. [Refer: Associates [member]; Investments accounted for using equity method; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Current payables to related parties
doc: The amount of current payables due to related parties. [Refer: Related parties [member]; Payables to related parties]

tlabel: Current trade payables
doc: The current amount of payment due to suppliers for goods and services used in entity's business. [Refer: Current liabilities; Trade payables]

tlabel: Write-downs (reversals of write-downs) of property, plant and equipment
doc: The amount recognised resulting from the write-down of property, plant and equipment to its recoverable amount or reversals of those write-downs. [Refer: Property, plant and equipment]

tlabel: Accrued Profit Sharing Bonus To Employees And Compensation To Directors And Supervisors
doc: Accrued profit sharing bonus to employees and compensation to directors and supervisors.

tlabel: Adjustments For Decrease Increase In Financial Assets And Liabilities At Fair Value Through Profit Or Loss
doc: Adjustments For Decrease Increase In Financial Assets And Liabilities At Fair Value Through Profit Or Loss

tlabel: Adjustments For Decrease Increase In Other Financial Assets
doc: Adjustments for decrease increase in other financial assets.

tlabel: Adjustments for Decrease Increase in Other Non Current Assets
doc: Adjustments for decrease (increase) in other noncurrent assets to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities.

tlabel: Adjustments for decrease (increase) in other receivables related parties
doc: Adjustments for decrease (increase) in other receivables related parties.

tlabel: Adjustments For Decrease Increase In Receivables From Related Parties
doc: Adjustments for decrease (increase) in receivables from related parties.

tlabel: Adjustments for Gain on disposal of intangible assets net
doc: The gain on the disposal of intangible assets. [Refer: intangible assets].

tlabel: Adjustments for gains (losses) on disposal of investments in debt instruments at fair value through other comprehensive income, net
doc: The gains (losses) on disposal of investments in debt instruments at fair value through other comprehensive income. [Refer: Financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income].

tlabel: Adjustments for gains (losses) on financial instruments at fair value through profit or loss, net
doc: The gains (losses) on financial instruments at fair value through profit or loss. [Refer: Financial assets and liabilities at fair value through profit or loss].

tlabel: Adjustments for increase decrease in accrued expenses and other current liabilities
doc: Adjustments for increase decrease in accrued expenses and other current liabilities.

tlabel: Adjustments For Increase Decrease In Accrued Profit Sharing Bonus To Employees And Compensation To Directors And Supervisors
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in accrued profit sharing bonus to employees and compensation to directors and supervisors.

tlabel: Adjustments For Increase Decrease In Other Liabilities Noncurrent
doc: Adjustments for increase decrease in other liabilities noncurrent.

tlabel: Adjustments For Increase Decrease In Payables To Related Parties
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in payables to related parties.

tlabel: Adjustments For Increase Decrease In Salary And Bonus Payables
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in salary and bonus payables to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities.

tlabel: Increase in prepayments for leases
doc: Adjustments for prepayments of leases.

tlabel: Adjustments For Recognition Of Expected Credit Loss And Reversal On Investments In Debt Instruments
doc: Adjustments for recognition of expected credit loss and reversal on investments in debt instruments.

tlabel: Capital Surplus
doc: The amount of capital surplus.

tlabel: Current Receivables From Related Parties Related To Core Business
doc: Current receivables from related parties related to core business.

tlabel: Derecognition Of Hedging Financial Instruments
doc: The cash inflow (outflow) from derecognition of hedging financial instruments.

tlabel: Donation From Shareholder Classified As Financing Activities
doc: Donation from shareholder classified as financing activities.

tlabel: Financial assets held for hedging
doc: The amount of derivative financial assets held for hedging. [Refer: Derivative financial assets].

tlabel: Financial liabilities held for hedging
doc: The amount of derivative financial liabilities held for hedging. [Refer: Derivative financial liabilities].

tlabel: From Difference Between The Consideration Received And The Carrying Amount Of The Subsidiaries Net Assets During Actual Disposal
doc: From difference between the consideration received and the carrying amount of the subsidiaries' net assets during actual disposal.

tlabel: Gain On Hedging Instruments That Will Be Reclassified To Profit Or Loss Before Tax
doc: Gain on hedging instruments that will be reclassified to profit or loss before tax.

tlabel: Guarantee Deposits Received Classified As Financing Activities
doc: Guarantee deposits received classified as financing activities.

tlabel: Guarantee Deposits Refunded Classified As Financing Activities
doc: Guarantee deposits refunded classified as financing activities.

tlabel: Increase decrease through basis adjustment for loss on hedging instruments
doc: Increase decrease through basis adjustment for loss on hedging instruments.

tlabel: Increase (decrease) through change in associates and joint venture
doc: Increase (decrease) through change in associates and joint venture.

tlabel: Increase (decrease) through disposal of investments accounted for using equity method
doc: Increase (decrease) through disposal of investments accounted for using equity method.

tlabel: Income Interest
doc: Investment income interest.

tlabel: Net Foreign Exchange Gain Loss
doc: Net foreign exchange gain (loss).

tlabel: Noncurrent guarantee deposits
doc: The amount of non-current guarantee deposits.

tlabel: Non Operating Income Expense1
doc: The aggregate amount of non-operating income (expenses).

tlabel: Other current receivables from related parties
doc: The amounts receivable resulting from related party transactions not relating to core business.

tlabel: Payment For Acquire Of Treasury Shares
doc: Payment for acquire of treasury shares.

tlabel: Payments Proceeds From Changes In Noncontrolling Interests
doc: Cash inflow (outflow) for changes in noncontrolling interests.

tlabel: Proceeds from financial assets at amortized costs classified as investing activities
doc: The cash inflow from disposal or redemption of financial assets at amortized cost.

tlabel: proceeds from financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income classified as investing activities
doc: The cash inflow from disposal or redemption of financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income.

tlabel: Proceeds From Hedging Financial Liabilities
doc: Proceeds from hedging financial liabilities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Intangible Assets
doc: The cash inflow from disposal or redemption of intangible assets, classified as investing activities. [Refer: Intangible assets other than goodwill]

tlabel: Proceeds from return of capital of investments in equity instruments at fair value through other comprehensive income
doc: The cash inflow from the return of capital of investments in equity instruments at fair value through other comprehensive income. [Refer: Investments in equity instruments at fair value through other comprehensive income]

tlabel: Purchase of Financial Assets At Amortised Cost
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of financial assets at amortized cost. [Refer: Financial instruments at amortized cost]

tlabel: Purchase of financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income. [Refer:Financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income].

tlabel: Purchase of Financial Assets at Fair Value Through Profit or Loss Debt Instruments
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of financial assets at fair value through profit or loss debt instruments. [Refer: Financial instruments at fair value through profit or loss].

tlabel: Salary and bonus payable, employee benefits accruals
doc: Salary and bonus payable, employee benefits accruals.

tlabel: Share of other comprehensive income of associates accounted for using equity method that will be reclassified to profit or loss, before tax
doc: Share of other comprehensive income of associates accounted for using equity method that will be reclassified to profit or loss, before tax.

tlabel: Share of other comprehensive income of associates accounted for using equity method that will not be reclassified to profit or loss, before tax
doc: Share of other comprehensive income of associates accounted for using equity method that will not be reclassified to profit or loss, before tax.

tlabel: Special Capital reserve
doc: Special capital reserve.

tlabel: Unappropriated earnings
doc: Unappropriated earnings.
